title: Towards Massive Multilingual Holistic Bias
reasoning: The paper presents the MASSIVE MULTILINGUAL HOLISTICBIAS (MMHB) benchmark, which specifically evaluates bias across 13 demographic axes, one of which is 'Religion'. Table 5 provides an extensive list of religious descriptors (e.g., agnostic, Buddhist, Catholic, Hindu, Muslim, etc.) used in the benchmark to measure bias and toxicity in language models.
